items.title: Black Friday bei Temu, Shein & Co: Wenn das Schnäppchen beim Zoll landet
items.teaser: Markensneaker für 39 Euro, dann kommt Post vom Zoll. Die EU-Kommission wirft Temu vor, zu wenig gegen illegale Angebote zu tun. Und die Kunden? Was diese von Verkäufer und Marktplatz verlangen können, erläutert

items.title: Bundesanwaltschaft - Festnahme von drei mutmaßlichen Mitgliedern von rechtsextremistischer Gruppe
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer rechtsextremistischen Vereinigung festnehmen lassen. Wie die Behörde mitteilte, handelt es sich um Jugendliche aus Brandenburg, Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein.

items.title: Russia drops 500-kg FAB-500 bomb on Sloviansk
items.teaser: Russian forces have dropped a 500-kilogram FAB-500 glide bomb on central Sloviansk in the Donetsk region, killing one person and injuring another.

items.title: Ukraine ready for next POW exchange, Coordination Headquarters secretary says
items.teaser: Dmytro Usov, secretary of Ukraine’s Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War, visited Russian POWs at a detention camp.

items.title: Ukraine: Industrial attacks and anger at Russia as Ukraine's allies justify defense aid, argue over military action in Libya
items.teaser: Moscow and Kyiv traded infrastructure attacks as allies argued over Ukraine's actions in Libya. Poland says it is puzzled by the lack of a US response to Russian incursions in its airspace. Follow DW for the latest.

items.title: Ukraine’s first Lynx IFVs arrive with airburst shells and a counter-drone role they weren’t optimized for
items.teaser: Troops plan to fire 30mm airburst rounds at enemy drones, though The War Zone notes the vehicle has no visible radar.

items.title: Parliament approves Ukraine’s accession to Steering Committee of Special Tribunal on Russian Aggression
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada has ratified the Enlarged Partial Agreement on the Steering Committee of the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine, a key step toward securing the tribunal’s funding and enabling it to begin operations.

items.title: "Wildberries has just ditched us": Russian sellers complain in droves about unpaid compensation
items.teaser: Russian sellers say Wildberries has failed to compensate them for goods destroyed in warehouse fires or pay them for items already sold.

items.title: HUR deep-strike destroys Russia’s unique aerospace reconnaissance system
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence (HUR) has destroyed a Russian aerospace reconnaissance and information system in a deep-strike operation.

items.title: Hungary considers buying Ukrainian maize and selling diesel fuel to Ukraine
items.teaser: Hungary is considering importing Ukrainian maize to address domestic shortages and selling surplus diesel fuel to Ukraine as part of closer economic and energy cooperation.

items.title: Ukraine needs at least €115 billion to hold firm in 2027. Zelenskyy expects €90 billion from the EU, and €25 billion has yet to be found
items.teaser: Half of that EU money is a new loan four member states want no part of, and Berlin has made the EU budget conditional on every member state helping fund Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine's PM says overnight Russian attacks targeted energy and logistics
items.teaser: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has said overnight Russian strikes targeted substations, power generation facilities, power lines and gas sites in four oblasts – with Zaporizhzhia the hardest hit. One person was killed in Kyiv Oblast

items.title: Russian attack on industrial facility and parking lot in Zhytomyr Region kills one, injures five
items.teaser: One person was killed and five others injured in a Russian attack on the Malyn community in Zhytomyr region.

items.title: "Terror 18": Drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder von rechtsextremer Gruppe festgenommen
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat die mutmaßlich rechtsextremistische Gruppe "Terror 18" zerschlagen. Bei einer bundesweiten Razzia sind drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder festgenommen worden. Unter ihnen ist auch ein Jugendlicher aus Brandenburg.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 9, injure 59 across Ukraine over past day, halt power generation at thermal power plant
items.teaser: Russian forces launched 112 drones, including 66 jet-powered ones, and decoys at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 24, the Air Force said.

items.title: Ukrainian soldier rescued a dog during the Kursk Operation. Now she’s his constant companion
items.teaser: Vladyslav Budivskyi, a platoon commander in the unmanned systems unit of the 199th Air Assault Forces Training Center, rescued an exhausted German-Australian Shepherd in Sudzha during the Kursk operation. The dog, whom he named Princess, now goes everywhere with him.

items.title: Ukrainian forces have struck aircraft at Russia's Savasleyka airbase, General Staff reports
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says five aircraft have been hit at the Savasleyka airbase in Russia’s Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, particularly three MiG-31s and two Su-34s.

items.title: "Terror 18": Rechtsextreme Jugendgruppe plante offenbar Anschlag - Festnahmen
items.teaser: Das BKA nahm nach Anschlagsplänen in Winsen (Luhe) unter anderem zwei Jugendliche aus dem Raum Helmstedt und Itzehoe fest.

items.title: Naftogaz facility in Poltava Region halts operations after Russian attack
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck a Naftogaz Group facility in Ukraine’s Poltava region, forcing it to suspend operations.

items.title: US-Botschaft rät US-Bürgern angesichts der russischen Angriffe davon ab, in die Ukraine zu reisen
items.teaser: Die Botschaft der Vereinigten Staaten rieg ihre Bürger dazu auf, wegen der russischen Luftangriffe auf Reisen in die Ukraine zu verzichten.

items.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces strike Savasleyka airfield, destroy five aircraft used in attacks on Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces have struck the Russian Savasleyka airfield, which hosts MiG-31K aircraft capable of carrying Kinzhal missiles.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike two Russian oil refineries
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Forces, in coordination with the “Black Spark” resistance movement, struck two oil refineries in Russia’s Samara region, Ukraine’s General Staff has said.

items.title: Ukrainische Angriffe auf russische Schiffe: Weitet der Konflikt sich aus?
items.teaser: Attacken auf russische Schiffe reichen inzwischen bis ins Mittelmeer. Kiew setzt Moskau global unter Druck - mit möglichen Folgen für Europa und den Handel auf den Weltmeeren. Wie groß ist die Gefahr einer Eskalation?

items.title: Two injured in Russian attack on Zlatopil in Kharkiv Oblast
items.teaser: Two men were injured in a Russian attack on the city of Zlatopil in Kharkiv Oblast on 25 November.

items.title: Razzia bei rechtsextremistischer Gruppe "Terror 18"
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft ist in mehreren Bundesländern gegen die rechtsextremistische Gruppe "Terror 18" vorgegangen, die schwerste Straftaten geplant haben soll. Drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder wurden festgenommen - sie sind 14 und 15 Jahre alt.

items.title: Council of EU imposes stricter export restrictions on 15 Russian companies
items.teaser: The Council of the European Union decided on 25 November to add 15 Russian entities to the list of those subject to stricter export restrictions on dual-use goods and advanced technologies.

items.title: Ukraine passes landmark crypto bill that could generate $300 million annually
items.teaser: The bill sets a general income tax rate of 18% and a 5% military tax on transactions involving virtual assets. In the first year after the law comes into effect, withdrawals converted into traditional currency would be taxed at a preferential 5% rate.

items.title: Trump says he has set no deadline for Ukraine-Russia peace deal
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump said he had set no deadline for reaching a peace deal between Ukraine and Russia, saying he hoped the war would end as soon as possible.

items.title: Ukrainian intelligence destroys Russian aerospace reconnaissance system in Smolensk Oblast
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine says the system could detect low-radar-signature aircraft and cruise missiles at distances of up to 2,500 km

items.title: Samara double strike: Ukrainian defence forces strike two Rosneft oil refineries
items.teaser: Two oil refineries caught fire in Russia's Samara Oblast on the night of 24-25 November. Ukraine's defence forces struck the Kuibyshev oil refinery in Samara and the Syzran oil refinery in Syzran.

items.title: Putin ousts filmmaker from token human rights council in move against even curated dissent
items.teaser: Alexander Sokurov, best known abroad for his 2002 experimental film "Russian Ark," was a member of the so-called council since 2018. All of its members are hand-picked by Putin.

items.title: German-Ukrainian SPYS interceptor downs Russia’s new K5-K jet Geran in combat trials, maker says
items.teaser: The maker announced the kill the same day its 520 km/h record was reported, but its own speed figures keep changing.

items.title: One injured and apartment building damaged in Russian attack on Odesa, power and water supply disrupted
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked Odesa on the afternoon of 25 November, damaging an apartment building. One person is reported to have been injured. The attack has also disrupted electricity and water supplies and brought electric-powered public transport to a halt.

items.title: Latvian PM promises good news on Ukrainian grain exports
items.teaser: “Good news” on the transit and export of Ukrainian grain through Latvia is expected soon.

items.title: AfD fordert Klage gegen Haushalt - Merz nennt Etat "vertretbar"
items.teaser: Die Aufstellung des Haushalts habe "keinen Schönheitspreis verdient“, räumte der Kanzler ein. Doch er sei in der gegenwärtigen Lage vertretbar. Zuvor war er von AfD-Chef Chrupalla scharf kritisiert worden - auch in Sachen Ukraine.

items.title: Parliament approves Ukraine's accession to management committee of special tribunal for Russia
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada (Ukrainian Parliament) voted on Wednesday 25 November in favour of Ukraine joining the Enlarged Partial Agreement on the Management Committee of the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine. The bill was backed by 293 MPs.

items.title: Russian attack on Bila Tserkva kills one person, damages DIY superstore and Nova Poshta branch
items.teaser: One person was killed when Russian forces attacked the city of Bila Tserkva and the surrounding district in Kyiv Oblast overnight on 24-25 November. An Epicentr home improvement superstore, a branch of delivery service Nova Poshta and other civilian businesses were damaged.

items.title: Ukraine’s parliament passes law to legalize cryptocurrency
items.teaser: Ukrainian parliament, the Verkhovna Rada, has passed legislation legalizing the cryptocurrency market and establishing a tax framework for virtual asset transactions.

items.title: Rada verabschiedet Gesetz zur Legalisierung von Kryptowährungen
items.teaser: Die Werchowna Rada (Parlament – Anm. d. Red.) hat ein Gesetz zur Legalisierung von Kryptowährungen verabschiedet.

items.teaser:

items.title: Berehove could become a symbol of Ukraine-Hungary cooperation – Mayor
items.teaser: Berehove Mayor Zoltán Babják called the Ukrainian-Hungarian leaders’ meeting in the city a historic event for the community and an opportunity to attract investment.

items.title: New €45 billion support instrument to cover two-thirds of Ukraine’s 2027 Needs – von der Leyen
items.teaser: The European Union will continue to provide comprehensive support to Ukraine, from funding hospitals and schools to supplying drones and interceptors. It has proposed a new €45 billion financing mechanism to support Ukraine in 2027.

items.title: One person killed, four injured as Russian forces attack enterprise in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: One person was killed and four others injured in a Russian attack on the Malyn community in the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: Ukrainian drones made in Canada? TAF Industries signs its first partnership beyond Europe
items.teaser: TAF says it and Canada's Draganfly intend to make drones in Canada mainly for Ukraine's Armed Forces. Zelenskyy's office said in September that Ukraine would get 30% of drones from a Ukrainian-Canadian program.

items.title: German chancellor: Russia wants more than Ukraine
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says Russia is escalating tensions in the Baltic region, Poland, the Black Sea and outer space, as well as within Germany.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia NPP loses external power supply after Russian attack
items.teaser: The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant lost its external power supply following a Russian attack and is currently operating on diesel generators.

items.title: AKW Saporischschja verliert nach russischem Beschuss externe Stromversorgung
items.teaser: Das Kernkraftwerk Saporischschja hat aufgrund feindlichen Beschusses die externe Stromversorgung verloren.

items.title: Estonia’s FM arrives in Kyiv
items.teaser: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has arrived in Kyiv on an official visit.

items.title: Russian attack severely damages thermal power plant, forcing shutdown
items.teaser: Ukraine's largest private energy company DTEK has reported that a massive Russian strike has severely damaged equipment at one of its thermal power plants, halting generation for the third time in November

items.title: Results of Zelensky-Magyar meeting expected in January-February, ambassador says
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Hungary, Fedir Shandor, said that the results of the meeting between President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar would become clear in January-February.

items.title: Ukrainian parliament legalises cryptocurrency and establishes taxation rules
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada (Ukrainian Parliament) has passed a law establishing new rules for the cryptocurrency market at its second reading.

items.title: Razzia bei rechter Terrorgruppe – Jugendliche festgenommen
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer rechtsextremistischen Terrorgruppe festnehmen lassen.

items.title: One killed and three injured in yet another Russian attack on Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a car park in the Malyn hromada in Zhytomyr Oblast on the morning of 25 November, killing one person and injuring three others after earlier overnight strikes hit regional energy and business sites

items.title: "Terror 18": Razzia bei rechtsextremistischer deutscher Gruppe
items.teaser: Deutschlandweite Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen in drei Bundesländern: Im Visier der Ermittler stehen mehrere Jugendliche. Was hat das mit der Internetgruppe "Terror 18" zu tun?

items.title: Time includes photos from Ukraine in its Top 100 Photos of 2026
items.teaser: Works by Kostiantyn Liberov, Serhii Korovainyi, Marylise Vigneau, Mauricio Lima, Johanna Maria Fritz and Gerd Ludwig in Ukraine were selected for Time's Top 100 Photos of 2026.

items.title: SSU foils assassination attempt on commander of Special Operations Forces unit
items.teaser: The SSU military counterintelligence department in the Kharkiv region, with the assistance of the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the command of the Ukrainian Special Operations Forces, foiled a contract killing plot targeting the commander of one of the Defense Forces' largest classified units.

items.title: Wohnungen durchsucht: Razzia bei rechter Terrorgruppe - Jugendliche festgenommen
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft lässt drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer rechtsextremistischen Terrorgruppe festnehmen. Sie soll unter anderem einen Brandanschlag auf eine Flüchtlingsunterkunft geplant haben. In mehreren Bundesländern finden Durchsuchungen statt.

items.title: Estonian foreign minister arrives in Kyiv
items.teaser: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has arrived in Ukraine on a visit.

items.title: International Arbitration in a Changing World: China Arbitration Summit 2026
items.teaser: The China Arbitration Summit and High-Level Dialogue on Maritime and Commercial Arbitration (the “Summit”) was held on 18 September 2026 as the flagship event of China Arbitration Week 2026 . The Summit commemorated two significant milestones: the 60th anniversary of the United Nations Commission on International Trade

items.title: Russia has around 100 troops inside Kupiansk, with no sign of encirclement – Tregubov
items.teaser: The number of Russian troops who have managed to infiltrate Kupiansk remains at around 100.

items.title: Gas facility in Poltava Oblast halts operations due to Russian strike
items.teaser: Acting Naftogaz CEO Serhii Fedorenko reported that a Russian attack on gas production infrastructure in Poltava Oblast overnight on 24-25 November triggered a major fire and halted operations at the facility

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages über 200 Gefechte an der Front, die Mehrheit davon in Richtung Pokrowsk 28 Angriffe gestoppt
items.teaser: Am 24. November kam es zu 203 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front, wobei die meisten feindlichen Angriffe im Raum Pokrowsk stattfanden.

items.title: Police post photos of 16-storey Kyiv apartment block damaged by Russian drone
items.teaser: Law enforcement officers have posted photos of damaged buildings, a kindergarten, a hotel and cars in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district after Russian drone debris struck a 16-storey residential block on 24 November

items.title: Ukraine reports new power outages as occupied Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant switches to diesel generators
items.teaser: Russian attacks have caused new power outages in five Ukrainian oblasts, while the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant has lost external power for the 17th time this year.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kyiv rises to three
items.teaser: The number of people injured after a Russian drone struck the courtyard of an apartment building in Kyiv’s Shevchenkivskyi district in the evening of November 24 has risen to three.

items.title: In Region Cherson ein Zivilist verletzt, 32 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 32 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurde ein Zivilist verletzt.

items.title: Merz: "Russland will mehr als die Ukraine"
items.teaser: Kanzler Merz räumt Defizite bei der Aufstellung des Haushalts ein, halte ihn aber für "vertretbar". Er wirbt für weitere Ukraine-Unterstützung und warnt vor Russlands Eskalationsversuchen.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia in morning attack, injuries, damage reported
items.teaser: Three people were injured in a Russian attack on the Shevchenkivskyi district of Zaporizhzhia on Wednesday morning, November 25.

items.title: The UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise: Affirming Status, Encouraging Co-operation
items.teaser: Introduction On 12 October 2026, the General Assembly formally endorsed, without a vote, the UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise (‘the Declaration’; A/81/L.3, GA/12794). Mandated by the General Assembly in 2024 (Decision 78/558), the Declaration was first approved by consensus at a high-level meeting on 24 September 2026

items.title: Russen beschießen vier Ortschaften und töten einen Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 24. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk einen Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Volyn region injures five, fire at enterprise extinguished
items.teaser: Five people were injured in a Russian attack in the Kovel district of the Volyn region in the evening of November 24.

items.title: Exclusive: US rules out troops, military bases in Ukraine under post-war security guarantees, falling short of Kyiv's expectations
items.teaser: Meanwhile, France, Italy, and the U.K. are among those supportive of bringing Ukraine into NATO, according to a readout of a Nov. 19 Coalition of the Willing meeting provided to the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,643,580 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,091 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Two Rosneft oil refineries in Russia’s Samara region on fire following drone attack – media
items.teaser: A fire broke out at an oil refinery in the city of Syzran, Samara region, Russia, on Wednesday amid a drone attack.

items.title: Zwei Rosneft-Raffinerien in russischer Region Samara brennen nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: In der Stadt Sysran in der Region Samara der Russischen Föderation kam es am Mittwoch, den 25. November nach einem Drohnenangriff zu einem Brand in einer Ölraffinerie.

items.title: Russian drones attack civilian and energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, one person injured
items.teaser: Russian drones targeted civilian and energy infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region, injuring one person.

items.title: Luftabwehr macht 88 von 112 russischen Drohnen unschädlich
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 88 von 112 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit dem Abend des 24. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Air defenses down 88 of 112 Russian drones targeting Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 112 attack drones overnight on the night of November 24-25.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 2091 weiteren Angreifern und 15 Artilleriesystemen
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 25. November 2024 bei rund 1.643.580 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 2091 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: War update: Over 200 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk axis hottest
items.teaser: As many as 203 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the front line on November 24, with the highest number of Russian attacks on the Pokrovsk axis.

items.title: One killed, seven injured as Russian drone hits minibus in Kharkiv region
items.teaser: A Russian drone attacked a minibus in Chuhuiv district, Kharkiv region, killing one person and injuring seven others.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,091 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 25, 2026, have reached approximately 1,643,580 personnel, including 2,091 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russia to step up influence operations against Western countries – expert
items.teaser: Western countries should prepare for an increase in Russian disinformation operations in the near future.

items.title: Russian attack kills 1, damages commercial infrastructure in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: Local Telegram channel Kyiv Holovne reported damage to facilities belonging to Ukrainian home improvement retailer Epicentr and postal and logistics company Nova Poshta, as well as other civilian businesses.

items.title: Days before key summit, EU countries want to help Ukraine, but can't agree on how
items.teaser: BRUSSELS, Belgium — Ukraine support has emerged as a rare point of consensus for EU countries otherwise at loggerheads over the future size and shape of the bloc's next long-term budget, but confusion reigns over every aspect of that support for Kyiv, according to several dispatches back to

items.title: Libya: 2 dead after Ukrainian attack on Russian warship in Benghazi
items.teaser: The head of the eastern administration in Libya has confirmed that two Libyan soldiers succumbed to their injuries. Ukraine's foreign minister defended the attack as an effort to counter Russian aggression.

items.title: Russian forces reduce assault attempts in Kharkiv region – SBGS
items.teaser: Russian forces have reduced their assault activity in the Kharkiv sector over the past week due to preventive actions by Ukraine's Defense Forces and deteriorating weather conditions.

items.title: Brücken-Krieg: Gefahr für Kiew, Probleme für Russlands Logistik
items.teaser: Kiew, Saporischschja, Odessa - immer wieder greift Russland ukrainische Brücken an. Im Gegenzug schießt die Ukraine vermehrt zurück - auch auf die Krim-Brücke. Dabei geht es beiden Seiten nicht immer nur um militärische Ziele. Von R. Barth.

items.title: Moldova and Romania plan to develop Prut River navigation with links to Ukraine
items.teaser: Moldova has proposed working with Romania to develop river infrastructure and restore navigation on the Prut River, partly to strengthen transport links with Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike 2 Russian oil refineries in massive attack
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces struck two Russian oil refineries, setting the sites ablaze in a massive attack overnight on Nov. 25, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Officer suspected of torturing subordinates extradited from Mondova to Ukraine
items.teaser: A Ukrainian serviceman suspected of ill-treating his subordinates has been extradited from Moldova to Ukraine.

items.title: German city of Darmstadt donates generators to schools and kindergartens in Uzhhorod
items.teaser: A delegation from the German city of Darmstadt, led by Mayor Hanno Benz, has donated five high-capacity generators worth more than €116,000 to Uzhhorod to ensure uninterrupted operations at schools and kindergartens.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 2 in Odesa Oblast, including child, injure more in Kyiv
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Odesa Oblast killed two people, including a teenager, and injured one other person, while another strike on a Kyiv residential building courtyard injured two people in Ukraine's capital late on Nov. 24.

items.title: SSU arrests suspected Russian agent posing as volunteer to direct strikes on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has arrested a contract soldier who, according to investigators, had gone AWOL from his military unit and was helping Russian forces direct strikes on Kramatorsk in the Donetsk region.

items.title: Most Germans now oppose arming Ukraine. Far-right voters resist hardest: 88% against
items.teaser: Support has dropped 13 points in a year, even as Germany gave Kyiv €11.5 billion in 2026, a third of all partner aid.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1735: Ukrainian sources say Pentagon chief has not signed off on 60 Patriot missiles that allies paid for
items.teaser: Zelenskyy says Ukraine needs more F-16s and Gripens against Russia's jet-powered Shaheds, Ukraine is preparing its big cities for water and sewage outages after Russian strikes, and the EU has proposed a 22nd sanctions package.

items.title: Norwegian firm behind NASAMS air defense builds new system around cheap Ukrainian missiles. Called Desna, it already fires at Russian drones, Oslo says
items.teaser: Air defense missiles run short worldwide. Ukraine and Norway answer with Desna.

items.title: Debris from Russian drone causes fire in 16-story residential building in Kyiv
items.teaser: A fire broke out in a 16-story residential building in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district after debris from a Russian drone fell on it.

items.title: Zelensky presents Magyar with 1942 newspapers mentioning his great-grandfather, who worked in Mukachevo
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has presented Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar with historical newspapers from 1942 that mention his great-grandfather, who worked as a notary in Mukachevo. Magyar also recalled his first visit to the Zakarpattia region, where he brought humanitarian aid as a school student.

items.title: Hungary sees Ukraine's EU accession as lengthy process – Magyar
items.teaser: Hungary will continue providing humanitarian assistance to Ukraine but does not agree to linking its funding to the European Union's seven-year budget and views EU accession as a lengthy process.

items.title: Around 100 civilians trapped on occupied Kinburn Spit face winter without food or medicine. Ukraine seeks a humanitarian evacuation similar to Oleshky
items.teaser: Russian forces are preventing residents from leaving the isolated peninsula, while shortages of food and essential medicines put the mostly elderly population at risk.

items.title: Russian drones strike Merefa, Lozova in Kharkiv region, six injured
items.teaser: Russian drones struck the cities of Merefa and Lozova in the Kharkiv region on the evening of November 24, injuring six people.

items.title: "Russisches Starlink" - Wie kann Rasswet den Ukraine-Krieg verändern?
items.teaser: Das US-Starlink-System von SpaceX spielt in der Ukraine eine wichtige Rolle bei der Abwehr der militärischen Aggression Russlands. Der Kreml hat nun beschlossen, ein Pendant dazu aufzubauen. Welche Gefahr birgt das?

items.title: Russian strikes on Odesa region kill two, including 17-year-old boy, injure three
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the Odesa region on the evening of November 24, killing a man and a 17-year-old boy and injuring three people.

items.title: People in occupied Donetsk and Luhansk are asking Putin to turn the lights back on. Two petitions have drawn over 55,000 signatures
items.teaser: Occupied Crimea will get 30% less power for up to ten days from 25 November, its Moscow-installed head said.

items.title: Ukraine seeks equal partnership with Hungary, support for its EU integration – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine seeks equal partnership with Hungary, support for its European integration path, and closer bilateral cooperation in energy, trade, infrastructure and security.

items.title: Rescuer killed in Russian shelling of Kramatorsk
items.teaser: A rescuer has been killed in a Russian attack on Kramatorsk.

items.title: Zehn Jahre nach FARC-Abkommen: Dutzende Verletzte bei Anschlag in Kolumbien
items.teaser: 2016 schließen die kolumbianische Regierung und die FARC ein Friedensabkommen. Fast auf den Tag genau zehn Jahre später explodiert eine Autobombe in der Stadt Villavicencio. Der Präsident macht eine Rebellen-Splittergruppe für den Anschlag verantwortlich.

items.title: Presidential Medal of Freedom: Donald Trump gewährt Rudy Giuliani höchste Ehren
items.teaser: Berühmt wurde er als Bürgermeister, als Terroristen das World Trade Center in New York angriffen. Doch in den vergangenen Jahren machte Rudy Giuliani vor allem mit Skandalen von sich reden - und als Anwalt von Donald Trump. Der zeichnet ihn nun aus.

items.title: Ukraine allocates nearly UAH 2B for distributed generation this year – Shmyhal
items.teaser: About UAH 2 billion was allocated from the state budget this year to develop distributed generation in Ukrainian communities.

items.title: Two killed and three injured, including child, in Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast – photo
items.teaser: Two people, aged 41 and 17, have been killed and three others, including a 12-year-old child, have been injured in Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast.

items.title: Zelenskyy summarises meeting with Hungarian PM: energy, trade and support discussed

items.title: Hundreds of Ukrainian defense tech companies already use AI – Zelensky

items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.title: Sky News documentary on Ukrainian National Guard soldiers wins International Emmy Award
items.teaser: Sky News documentary 24 Hours in the Kill Zone, filmed alongside soldiers of the Ukrainian National Guard’s Rubizh Brigade, has won an International Emmy Award in the Best News category.

items.title: Russen töten zwei und verletzen fünf Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 23. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk zwei Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Ukraine's unfinished fight to reform its law enforcement agencies
items.teaser: A sweeping investigation by Ukraine's anti-corruption agencies this year has exposed a long-standing problem within the country's law enforcement system and renewed calls for reform. Officials within Ukraine's unreformed law enforcement agencies have allegedly worked in concert with organized crime groups, providing pr

items.title: Selenskyj zum Angriff auf zwei russische Schiffe vor libyscher Küste: Ukrainische Marineoperationen werden fortgesetzt
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte in seiner abendlichen Videoansprache zu der ukrainischen Operation vor der libyschen Küste gegen zwei russische Schiffe, die Ukraine reagiere angemessen auf die russischen Angriffe, und die Marineoperationen würden fortgesetzt.

items.title: Over 80% of surveyed Germans view Russia as a military threat to Germany
items.teaser: Körber-Stiftung's 2026/27 The Berlin Pulse survey shows 82% of Germans consider Russia under Vladimir Putin a military threat, while 51% back decisive responses to hybrid attacks and 83% favour US-China neutrality.

items.title: Nvidia-Skandal: US-Regierung setzt Megaspeed auf schwarze Liste
items.teaser: Die Firma Megaspeed erlangte innerhalb kurzer Zeit weltweite Aufmerksamkeit. Grund war die Affäre von Nvidia-Chef Huang mit einer früheren Managerin des Unternehmens, die der Spionage verdächtigt wird. Nun landete Megaspeed auf einer US-Sperrliste.

items.title: Majority of Germans favour ending arms supplies to Ukraine – poll
items.teaser: An annual survey commissioned by the Körber Foundation reveals growing opposition to arms deliveries to Ukraine among German voters, despite 82% of respondents viewing Russia as a military threat to Germany.

items.title: Ukraine government welcomes newly proposed EU sanctions package
items.teaser: "Pressure on the aggressor's finances and energy sector, enforcement against evasion, and the proposed ban on Russian ex-combatants entering the EU all strengthen the security of Ukraine and of Europe," said Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi.

items.title: Russian attack damages business, energy facility in Vinnytsia, injuring four
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Vinnytsia damaged a civilian business and an energy facility, leaving four people injured.

items.title: Greece is developing an alternative route for Ukrainian grain exports
items.teaser: As Russian attacks on Black Sea ports and Danube drought disrupt shipments, Greece is designing a two-way rail corridor via Alexandroupolis and Thessaloniki to bring Ukrainian grain to global markets.

items.title: In Region Cherson ein Zivilist verletzt, 27 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 27 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurde ein Zivilist verletzt.

items.title: EJIL: The Podcast! Episode 48: Holding a state responsible for genocide: Gambia v Myanmar before the ICJ
items.teaser: The ICJ’s judgment in Gambia v Myanmar has been eagerly received, not least in the Cox’s Bazaar camp where Rohingya survivors watched live as judgment was rendered. The Genocide Convention gives the ICJ jurisdiction in cases of alleged genocide which it does not enjoy in respect of other atrocity crimes (like crimes ag

items.title: Ukraine still awaiting Hegseth's approval for delivery of around 60 Patriot missiles – FT
items.teaser: The Financial Times reports that deliveries of PAC-2 and PAC-3 interceptor missiles allocated to Ukraine are awaiting Pentagon approval. A separate initiative to enable Ukraine to manufacture its own Patriot interceptors has also been delayed.

items.title: Russian strikes damage civilian and energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr Region
items.teaser: Russian forces have again struck civilian and energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, causing damage.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,641,489 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,848 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: General Staff reports 161 combat clashes on front line over past day
items.teaser: A total of 161 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian troops were recorded along the front line on November 23.

items.title: "While you were sleeping, we won": Film about Ukrainian Brigade fighters wins International Emmy
items.teaser: Producer Azad Safarov announced that Sky News's 24 Hours in the Kill Zone – the sole Ukraine-focused nominee – won an International Emmy Award after documenting a six-hour frontline rescue mission.

items.title: Air defenses neutralize 73 of 96 drones Russia launched against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defenses neutralized 73 of the 96 drones Russian forces launched against the country from the evening of November 23 into the morning of November 24.

items.title: Angriff auf Saporischschja tötet zwei und verletzt 40 Menschen
items.teaser: In der Stadt Saporischschja ist die Zahl der Verletzten nach dem russischen Angriff auf 40 gestiegen, zwei Menschen wurden getötet.

items.title: Germany to become first country granted access to Ukraine’s DELTA combat system
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius have signed a letter of intent in Berlin on cooperation in the development, deployment and use of the DELTA combat digital ecosystem.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 54 Ortschaften beschossen, zwei Zivilisten getötet, 31 verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 54 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 687 Mal.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia rises to 40; two killed
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia has risen to 40, while two others were killed.

items.title: Ukrainian air defences down 73 Russian drones overnight, strikes recorded at 13 locations
items.teaser: Russian forces launched Shahed, Gerbera and decoy drones against Ukraine overnight. Strikes were recorded at 13 locations, and the attack is ongoing.

items.title: Die juristische Presseschau vom 24. November 2026: Archiv geht an Zeugen Jehovas / Kamikaze-Drohnen völkerrechtswidrig? / EGMR vor Pushback-Entscheidung
items.teaser: Der Bund will nach Vergleich Dokumente zur NS-Verfolgung von Familie Kusserow abgeben. Gutachten warnt vor unkontrollierten Tötungen durch Kamikaze-Drohnen. Der EGMR entscheidet heute über Pushbacks von Polen, Lettland und Litauen.

items.title: Russian strike on Dymer claims 12 lives as woman rescued from under rubble dies in hospital
items.teaser: A 79-year-old woman rescued from under the rubble of a residential building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, has died despite doctors' efforts to save her life. The youngest victim of the Russian attack was 11 years old.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,848 over past day
items.teaser: Russia has lost an estimated 1,641,489 troops in its full-scale war against Ukraine since February 24, 2022, including 1,848 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: 1848 Soldaten - Kampfverluste der Russen am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 24. November 2026 werden auf etwa 1.641489 (+1848 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Tusk urges V4 partners to support Ukraine amid Russian aggression
items.teaser: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has called on Visegrad Group countries to jointly support Ukraine and show solidarity with Poland amid Russian aggression, which poses a threat to European countries.

items.title: Weapons, war and wavering trust: Germans want to see more restraint in foreign policy
items.teaser: According to a study by the Körber Foundation, a growing number of Germans now oppose providing military aid to Ukraine. The majority also believes that Germany should take a neutral position between the US and China.

items.title: Ukraine and Germany reach preliminary agreement on additional interceptor missiles for Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara and his German counterpart Boris Pistorius discussed strengthening Ukraine's air defences, defence industry cooperation and drone procurement for 2027 during a meeting in Berlin.

items.title: Ukrainian drone units hit over 4,000 Russian ground robotic systems this year
items.teaser: Unmanned systems units of Ukraine's Defense Forces have destroyed or disabled 4,073 Russian ground robotic systems since the beginning of this year.

items.title: Russians attack three districts of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast with drones, injuring two men in Pavlohrad
items.teaser: Russian drones targeted the Pavlohrad, Samar and Nikopol districts, causing a fire in Pavlohrad and damaging storage facilities in the Samar district. Two men aged 29 and 36 are receiving outpatient treatment.

items.title: Gen-Z-Proteste: Verfassungsschutz warnt vor Beeinflussung durch Linksextreme
items.teaser: Beim "Schulstreik gegen Wehrpflicht" sollen laut Verfassungsschutz linksextremistische Gruppen maßgeblich beteiligt sein.

items.title: Studie: Mehrheit der Deutschen gegen mehr Waffen für Ukraine
items.teaser: Immer mehr Deutsche finden, das Land solle sich außenpolitisch zurückhalten. Eine Mehrheit ist gegen Waffen-Hilfen für die Ukraine. Und dafür, dass das Land eine neutrale Position im Streit der USA mit China einnimmt.

items.title: Lithuania provides Ukraine with over USD 1B in military aid since 2022 – General Staff
items.teaser: Lithuania has provided Ukraine with more than $1 billion in military assistance since the beginning of 2022.

items.title: Russian forces attack Vinnytsia twice: fire breaks out, one person injured
items.teaser: Emergency crews are working at the scene of a fire in Vinnytsia following a Russian drone attack on 24 November. Ukraine's Air Force had earlier warned of a jet-powered drone approaching the city.

items.title: Greece developing route for Ukrainian grain exports via Alexandroupolis port – media
items.teaser: Greece is working on a pilot route to export Ukrainian grain to global markets via the port of Alexandroupolis, with an initial test shipment potentially being delivered to the port by rail.

items.title: Exclusive: Freshly made European, American components found in Russian drones attacking Ukraine
items.teaser: Note: This story was produced in collaboration with the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP), De Tijd (Belgium), 15min (Lithuania) and Paper Trail Media (Germany). items.title: Russia loses almost 1,848 soldiers and 55 artillery systems over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,848 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russian drone enters Polish airspace during attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: A Russian drone violated Polish airspace during an attack on western Ukraine. Poland's military said they decided to refrain from using weapons due to the risk of causing damage to civilians.

items.title: Verfassungsschutz: Wann geraten Moscheen ins Visier?
Russian forces attack Zaporizhzhia, killing two people and injuring 40 – photos
items.teaser: Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia on 24 November destroyed a house, partially destroyed a five-storey residential building and damaged transport infrastructure.

items.title: Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia leave two people killed, 11 injured, houses destroyed
items.teaser: Two people were killed and 11 injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, which damaged apartment buildings, private houses and a transport infrastructure facility.

items.title: 2 killed, 44 injured in Russian attack on residential building in Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: Mykhailo Semikin, the head of the Zaporizhzhia Oblast Military Administration, reported that Russian forces partially destroyed a five-story residential building in the Kosmichnyi district of the city.

items.title: Russia develops new reconnaissance version of Molniya drone with gasoline engine – presidential advisor
items.teaser: Russian forces have developed a new reconnaissance version of the Molniya unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a gasoline engine.

items.title: Hungarian PM says he will visit Zakarpattia region soon
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Monday that he would visit Ukraine's Zakarpattia region soon to express his support for the ethnic Hungarian minority living there.

items.title: Russian aircraft enter South Korea's air defence identification zone – Yonhap
items.teaser: Russian military aircraft briefly entered South Korea's air defence identification zone near Ulleungdo on 24 November, prompting an evacuation warning after they were mistakenly identified as potentially North Korean aircraft.

items.title: Explosion, fire reported after drone crashes in Transnistria
items.teaser: Moldova's IPN news agency reported that the drone crashed around 6:45 p.m. local time near the town of Dnestrovsc, which is located adjacent to the Ukrainian border in Odesa Oblast. Eyewitnesses told IPN that the drone exploded on impact with a fire reported near a gas station.

items.title: Deutschland baut künftig ukrainische Drohnen
items.teaser: Bereits im April hatten Deutschland und die Ukraine vereinbart, militärisch enger zusammenzuarbeiten - etwa beim Drohnenbau. Verteidigungsminister Pistorius wurde nun konkreter. Mit Blick auf mögliche russische Angriffspläne im All mahnte er zur Ruhe.

items.title: Ukraine's foreign minister warns Russian strikes on ports threaten global food security
items.teaser: Andrii Sybiha has warned that Russian attacks on Ukrainian export infrastructure threaten the livelihoods of millions worldwide, stressing that the consequences of Russia's war extend far beyond Europe.

items.title: Olga Kharlan calls on Melania Trump to help secure release of civilians from Kinburn Spit
items.teaser: Olympic fencing champion Olga Kharlan, who hails from Mykolaiv, has appealed to U.S. First Lady Melania Trump to help secure the release of civilians from the temporarily occupied Kinburn Spit.

items.title: Russian unmanned aerial vehicle violates Polish airspace days after missile incursion
items.teaser: Around 11 p.m. local time, Poland's Government Security Center issued an air-attack alert in parts of the Lublin region in the country's east. About an hour later, the alert was ended.

items.title: NATO secretary general comments on reports of Russia's possible deployment of nuclear weapons in space
items.teaser: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has reaffirmed the Alliance's commitment to protecting its members against threats in space, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has expressed concern over Russia's potential deployment of nuclear weapons in orbit.

items.title: Estonia must get used to Ukrainian drone attacks in the Baltic Sea, Prime Minister says
items.teaser: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Ukraine’s attacks on Russian vessels in the Baltic Sea were understandable, adding that such attacks were something countries should get used to and be prepared for.

items.title: Brazil requests dispute panel regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
items.teaser: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 November, members considered a request from Brazil for the establishment of a dispute panel to review additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974.

items.title: EU sanctions against terrorism: Council lists the founder of 'The Base'
items.teaser: The Council expands its sanctions list to combat terrorism by designating the founder and leader of the EU-sanctioned organisation 'The Base'.

items.title: Zelensky calls for NATO to admit Ukraine at alliance assembly
items.teaser: "Wouldn't it be more effective to simply admit Ukraine into NATO?" Zelensky said. "Wouldn't that be better for all of us, for everyone? Wouldn't it be more feasible? And wouldn't it be more reliable when it comes to actually guaranteeing security?"

items.title: Ukraine's Defense Forces destroy 1,004 Russian tanks since start of 2026
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces have destroyed 1,004 Russian tanks since the beginning of 2026, equivalent to approximately six Eiffel Towers in terms of total metal weight.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russian drone enters Poland during attack on Ukraine but is not shot down
items.teaser: The Polish military authorised the downing of a Russian drone that entered the country's airspace on 24 November but decided against opening fire due to the potential risk to civilians.

items.title: Russia lacks capability to recover Kerch Bridge spans from seabed – Ukrainian Navy spokesperson
items.teaser: Russia lacks the capability to raise the spans of the Kerch Bridge from the seabed, while foreign companies are unlikely to take part in the operation because the area is an active combat zone.

items.title: Christian Mölling, Think Tanks Edina, zum Ukraine-Krieg und einer gefährlichen Eskalation in Europa
items.teaser: Christian Mölling, Think Tanks Edina, zum Ukraine-Krieg und einer gefährlichen Eskalation in Europa

items.title: Ukrainian forces debunk Russian claims that they remotely mined city of Rylsk
items.teaser: Russia is attempting to shift responsibility onto Ukraine for explosions in the center of Rylsk, in Russia's Kursk region, where a police station had been turned into a drone workshop and ammunition depot.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1734: Merz says Ukraine in NATO in 2008 could have stopped war
items.teaser: Meanwhile, Ukrainian drones struck Russian ships from the Gulf of Finland to a Libyan port in November, sinking the corvette Mercury.

items.title: Ukraine in NATO could probably have stopped Russia’s war, German Chancellor Merz says, 18 years after Berlin helped shut the door
items.teaser: Meanwhile, NATO chief Mark Rutte warns that Russia’s war machine won’t stop when the war in Ukraine ends.

items.title: Russia repeatedly altered details on killing of imprisoned Ukrainian journalist Viktoriia Roshchyna
items.teaser: Hacked information provides the latest information about what happened to Roshchyna, a Ukrainska Pravda journalist who died in Russian captivity after torture in the fall of 2024. Roshchyna, 27, disappeared in August 2023 while reporting from Russian-occupied territories.
